subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only change in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 fully satisfy this issue, or must plugin-aware enum support remain in scope before closure?
rationale: The description directly addresses the observed agent confusion without changing validation, while an enum creates a broader model-facing contract that must preserve dynamically registered external channel plugins.

options.title: Accept Description-Only
options.body: Refresh and land the linked PR, then close this issue and defer enum work unless further evidence shows the description is insufficient.

options.title: Require Plugin-Aware Enum
options.body: Keep this issue open after the description patch until a lightweight canonical registry-derived enum covers bundled and external plugin ids.

recommendation.title: Accept Description-Only
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the linked PR, then close this issue and defer enum work unless further evidence shows the description is insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across all three decision surfaces and already reviewed the description-versus-enum boundary.
